info.title: QoffeeAutomat management API
info.description: The management API of the QoffeeAutomat agent. JSON with camelCase members; errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Every operation needs a session cookie, and operations that change state need the header X-QoffeeAutomat-Csrf: 1.

post.summary: Restarts the agent a moment after the response, so that changed ports and remote UI take effect.
Signs in with the password; the session is a cookie.

get.summary: Tells who is signed in.
Tells whether first-run setup is available (only until a password exists).

post.summary: Sets the first password with the setup token and signs in.

get.summary: Lists all commands.

post.summary: Creates a command; the id must not exist yet.
Validates and runs a draft command without saving it; the run is recorded in the history as a test run.
Validates a draft command without saving it.

get.summary: Reads a command; the ETag is its revision.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

patch.summary: Changes enabled and exposeToHa of a command.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

delete.summary: Deletes a command; its earlier revisions are kept.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

post.summary: Starts a run of a command with variables; answers as soon as the run is accepted.

get.summary: Downloads all commands, sensors, metric overrides, settings and scripts as a zip file. The archive contains no secrets.

post.summary: Imports a zip file made by the export. The whole archive is validated first; nothing is changed unless it is valid. Existing items with the same id are replaced.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: True also imports the settings; they belong to one PC, so the default is false.

post.summary: Validates a zip file made by the export and tells what an import would do to each item. Nothing is changed; an invalid archive is answered with valid false and the errors.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: True also reads the settings; they belong to one PC, so the default is false.

get.summary: Lists the kept revisions of a command, a sensor (kind command or sensor) or the settings (kind and id settings), newest first.

post.summary: Stores a kept revision as a new revision of the document.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

get.summary: Downloads a zip file with redacted settings, versions, counters and the recent log lines. It contains no token, password hash or private key.
Lists the recent events, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most events to return, 1 to 500; the default is 50.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only events of this type.

get.summary: Lists the paired QoffeeLink clients.

delete.summary: Revokes a paired client and closes its open connections.

get.summary: Reads the active pairing code; answers 204 when there is none.

post.summary: Starts pairing: creates a one-time code that is valid for five minutes and returns it with the certificate fingerprint.

get.summary: Reads the newest log entries, oldest first.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The lowest level: trace, debug, information, warning, error or critical; the default is information.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most entries to return, 1 to 1000; the default is 50.

get.summary: Lists the metric catalog with the current values.
Reads the recorded values of metrics, oldest first. Only metrics that were sampled have history.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated metric ids.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only values at or after this time (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Only values of the last this many seconds; ignored when since is given.

get.summary: Streams metric values as Server-Sent Events: a snapshot event, then update events with the changed values.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated metric ids, or * for all; the default is all.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: At most one value per this many seconds and metric.

get.summary: Reads one metric of the catalog.

put.summary: Sets the override of a metric; an override without members removes it. The ETag is the revision of all overrides.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

delete.summary: Removes the override of a metric.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

get.summary: Lists runs from the history, newest first.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Only runs of this command.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only runs from this source: ha, ui, hub, cli, sequence or test.

parameters.name: failed
parameters.description: True lists only runs that did not succeed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size, 1 to 200; the default is 50.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many of the newest matching runs to skip.

get.summary: Reads one run with its variables and output.
Streams the output of a run as Server-Sent Events: output events, then one end event. A running run is replayed from its start.
Lists the script files.
Reads a script file; the ETag is the hash of its bytes.

put.summary: Creates or replaces a script file.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

get.summary: Lists all custom sensors.

post.summary: Creates a custom sensor; the id must not exist yet.
Samples a draft sensor once without saving it.

get.summary: Reads a custom sensor; the ETag is its revision.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

delete.summary: Deletes a custom sensor; its earlier revisions are kept.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

get.summary: Reads the agent settings; the ETag is their revision.

put.summary: Replaces the agent settings. Ports and remote UI take effect after a restart.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the document as read; a stale value is refused with 412.

get.summary: Reports the version, uptime, platform, link clients, session state and the pause flag.
Returns this document.

csrfHeader.name: X-QoffeeAutomat-Csrf
csrfHeader.description: Anti-forgery header; the value must be 1.
